senses.gloss: पियाल पियाल, for original प्रियाल (q. cf.), m. A tree, Buchanania latifolia Roxb. n. Its fruit.
पीयूष् पीयूष्, a denomin. derived from पीयूष, Par. To turn into nectar, Śatr. 14, 81.

पीयूष पीयूष, probably पीवस् (ved. grease, cf. पीवन्), + अ,
 1. n. The food or beverage of the gods, nectar, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 838.
 2. m. and n. The milk of a cow during the first seven days after calving.
पीयूषवर्षाय पीयूषवर्षाय, a denomin. derived from पीयूष-वर्ष with य, Ātm. To turn into a shower of nectar, Bhartṛ. 2, 78.
पीयूष- + महस् पीयूष- + महस्, m. the moon.
